regime.instructions: Classify the current market regime for this instrument from the snapshot.

criteria.trending: returns persistent in one direction, flow agrees with returns
criteria.mean_reverting: returns oscillate, flow and book lean against recent moves
criteria.high_vol: realized volatility or spread clearly elevated without crash dynamics
criteria.crisis: disorderly: wide spread, one-sided flow, sharp drop, liquidity vanishing

direction.instructions: Which position, if any, has positive expectancy over the next few bars after paying the spread? Prefer neutral when evidence is mixed. Instrument ASTER-PERP. Research thesis (may be wrong): Reported unlock of ~78m ASTER on 2026-11-17 (~3.9% of market cap per one source) into a market with altcoin weakness and BTC dominance near 58-60%. Supply-overhang trade. Thesis is invalidated by: Unlock postponed or restructured; Funding below -30% annualized (carry kills the trade); Price rises through the unlock window on rising open interest. Judge only from the snapshot; the thesis is context, not a vote.

toxic_flow.instructions: Proposition: recent aggressive order flow is informed, so a new taker order in the direction of the flow would be adversely selected.
